test_OASISDiscriminatorLoss: test the OASISDiscriminatorLoss class by computing discriminator loss from real and fake logits with a target map
test_OASISGeneratorLoss: test the OASISGeneratorLoss class by computing generator loss from logits and a spatially-varying target map
run_OASISDiscriminatorLoss: run the OASISDiscriminatorLoss call with 4-D real logits, 4-D fake logits, and a 3-D target tensor
run_OASISGeneratorLoss: run the OASISGeneratorLoss call with 4-D logits and a 3-D ground truth label tensor
review_oasis_loss_tests: review the pytest test suite that validates OASIS discriminator and generator loss against expected cross-entropy values
